''See also: [[Cladia Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Cladia [[Arelius family|Arelius]] is a [[Sage]] of the [[Arelius family]], known as the [[Sage of a Thousand Eyes]]. She possesses [[light madra]] that manifests as a swarm of glowing orbs resembling bees. As a highly experienced [[Sage]], she considers her current level of [[Authority|authority]] to be at its peak, noting that reaching the rank of [[Monarch]] would require further [[advancement]] or a new [[Icon]] bond. Her history includes a near-fatal encounter with the [[Weeping Dragon]] nearly a decade ago, an event she survived only through personal preparation and a treasure provided by [[Tiberian Arelius]]. This specific treasure allows her to navigate potential futures by obscuring possibilities and evading the predictions of others. Cladia has previously experienced an [[Overlord revelation]] similar to [[Lindon]]'s. In her role, she provides protection for [[Arelius family|House Arelius]] and supports those fighting against threats like the [[Weeping Dragon]], though she intends to avoid direct combat with such entities herself due to the presence of roaming [[Monarchs]].}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Cladia has blonde hair that features streaks of gray. She is dressed in elegant, dark blue robes belonging to a [[sacred artist]].}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Cladia acts as an observer of those around her. She demonstrates a cautious nature by instructing her group to wait for a transfer to stabilize.}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Cladia shares a similar [[Overlord revelation]] with [[Eithan]]. She also provided a blessing to [[Mercy]] that enables the latter to see the [[Weeping Dragon]] with greater clarity.}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Known as the [[Sage of a Thousand Eyes]], Cladia utilizes [[light madra]]. She is capable of providing blessings to others and has been observed juggling a [[gatestone]].}}

== Waybound ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Cladia [[Arelius family|Arelius]], the [[Sage of a Thousand Eyes]] and an [[Akura clan|Akura family]] [[Archlady]], is a practitioner of [[light madra]]. Dressed in elegant [[sacred artist's robe|sacred artist's robes]] of dark blue, she was observed juggling a [[gatestone]] while watching over the others. During a critical moment, she instructed the group to remain still until the transfer had stabilized. She further assisted by providing a blessing that enabled [[Mercy]] to gain a clearer vision of the [[Weeping Dragon]].}}
